extension.description: Remote Pulse — a quiet, native-feeling indicator that continuously tracks your Remote-SSH host's CPU/memory/disk/network/GPU/Docker status.
command.showTrend.title: Remote Pulse: Show Trend Chart
command.refresh.title: Remote Pulse: Refresh Now
config.refreshInterval.description: Refresh interval for high-frequency foreground metrics (CPU/memory), in milliseconds
config.backgroundInterval.description: Reduced refresh interval used once the window loses focus, in milliseconds
config.heavyMetricInterval.description: Separate polling interval for low-frequency metrics like GPU/Docker, in milliseconds
config.statusBarMetric.description: Primary metric shown persistently in the status bar
config.warningThreshold.description: Warning threshold (percentage); the status bar switches to the warning color above it
config.criticalThreshold.description: Critical threshold (percentage); the status bar switches to the critical color above it
config.template.description: Status bar display template; ${value} is replaced with the current metric value
config.enableGpu.description: Whether to detect and show GPU info (requires nvidia-smi)
config.enableDocker.description: Whether to detect and show Docker container info (requires access to docker.sock)
config.enableNetwork.description: Whether to show network upload/download rates in the tooltip
config.enableNotifications.description: Whether to show a system notification when the critical threshold is crossed
config.diskMountPoints.description: Disk mount points to monitor; leave empty to auto-select the one with the highest usage
